Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter

Dear Ms. Mittal,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 March 2025 about your dispute with M/s Zenith Shipping Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the vessel is about to leave port. The matter is listed before the Gujarat High Court.

Our advice is to arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim. Please collect the salvage agreement and the logbook entries and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹13,46,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
